# Arsalan — Full-Stack Web Developer & Freelancer (ARZEN)

> Mohammad Arsalan Sheikh, known professionally as Arsalan (online handle ARZEN),
> is a freelance full-stack web developer based in Patna, Bihar, India. He builds
> business websites, full-stack web applications and custom web solutions for
> clients in India and internationally, using JavaScript end to end: Next.js
> (App Router), React, Node.js, MongoDB/Mongoose, Auth.js, Tailwind CSS and
> Framer Motion. He works remotely and is open to freelance projects and
> full-time roles. He is currently learning TypeScript.

## Services
- Business websites: fast, SEO-friendly marketing and brochure sites.
- Full-stack web applications: authentication, dashboards, CRUD, bookings,
  payment-flow integrations (Next.js + MongoDB + Auth.js).
- Custom web solutions: redesigns, booking/contact flows, scoped product builds.

## Projects
- NexBook — full-stack web application (secure multi-user notebook; Next.js,
  MongoDB, Mongoose, Auth.js, Tiptap, TanStack Query). Personal project.
  Demo: https://nexbook-one.vercel.app/ (source repository is private).
- IronVault Fitness — industry solution demonstration (gym website with
  membership flow; Next.js, MongoDB, Auth.js; payment and email integrations
  are pending and not production-ready).
  Source: https://github.com/arzenjs/ironvault-fitness
- CedarCare — industry solution demonstration (clinic website with
  appointment booking and staff dashboard; fictional clinic).
  Source: https://github.com/arzenjs/cedarcare
- Ember & Spice — industry solution demonstration (restaurant marketing site;
  Next.js 14, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion; fictional restaurant).
  Demo: https://ember-spice-seven.vercel.app/ · Source: https://github.com/arzenjs/ember-spice

Note: all four are independent builds and demonstrations, not paid client
engagements. Experiments live at https://github.com/arzenjs/arzen-dev-lab.
